title: Expired refresh token returns HTTP 500
body: Steps to reproduce: create an expired JWT refresh token and POST it to /auth/refresh. The latest release returns HTTP 500 instead of HTTP 401. This affects production and no workaround is available. Stack trace includes ExpiredSignatureError.

title: Refresh endpoint crashes on expired JWT
body: Minimal reproduction available. Calling /auth/refresh with an expired token raises ExpiredSignatureError and produces a 500 response.
